Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the first Planner response after the second WebSurfer turn), the Planner incorrectly states that the birth year of Robert M. Young is 1950 ("The Ballad of Gregorio Cortez — Director: Robert Young — Birth year: 1950"). This contradicts the verified fact established in the previous WebSurfer turn and the very first WebSurfer turn, which confirmed Robert M. Young was born in 1924. This hallucination of the birth year (1950 instead of 1924) is the critical error that leads to the incorrect final conclusion, as it makes the director of *The Ballad Of Gregorio Cortez* appear younger than the director of *Naiyya* (Prashanta Nanda, born around 1930s/40s), whereas in reality, Robert M. Young (1924) was born first.
